review.official:
Ch'en, former Lungmen superintendent and former head of the L.G.D.'s Special Inspection Unit, graduated from the Victorian Royal Guard Academy with superb marks and outstanding achievements. During her time with the Department, she cracked down on crime, fought violent offenders, tracked down armed fugitives, and brought down international criminals.
Having resigned from the L.G.D., she is now officially a member of Rhodes Island. In accordance with her wishes, she is mainly assigned to provide field operators adequate support and on-location guidance.
She continues to fight on the frontlines as a Rhodes Island Operator.

files.description:
Imaging tests show the indistinct outlines of internal organs, obscured by abnormal shadows. Originium granules detected in the circulatory system. The subject is confirmed to be infected with Oripathy.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 6%
Small traces of crystallization are visible on Operator Ch'en's body surface.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L

Ch'en's condition has deteriorated since her last checkup. We know her resolve and understand her reasons, but she must take better care of herself...
—Sussurro

You know how she is. Oripathy or not, she'll never listen.
—Warfarin

'Broken shields have been melted down into plowshares. The fire in the furnace has changed.
'The name Reunion is increasingly used to refer to a village, rather than a group of Infected.
'Oversight? I have my duty as an operator of Rhodes Island, but this is also a personal commitment for me. What is different about Nine's 'fairness'? What judgment will Talulah receive? Will a reborn Reunion truly light a lasting fire of hope in the snowstorm? Someone must bear witness, and it should be me. It must be me.'

Following the Londinium incident, Ch'en traveled throughout Ursus, from the disputed region at the Ursus-Kazimierz Border, to the Grypherburg region, to the distant north... We later learned that Ch'en operated like a Messenger, braving martial law, harsh weather, and magnetic storms to cross the tundra, establishing the basic framework of an intelligence network for Rhodes Island. Outside of the task force that the Doctor and Amiya personally led, Ch'en was our most reliable and stable source of information in the Ursus region. Ch'en's aptitude in intelligence gathering, already on display in Lungmen, provided invaluable help to Rhodes Island.

[Classified Log]
Ch'en did not conceal the fact that she met with Talulah's group, witnessing them unite a group of Infected on the tundra and establish a village by the name of Reunion. To Reunion, she was candid about her role, exercising oversight in her personal capacity, procuring necessary supplies, and sharing some Rhodes Island-compiled intel with them... Her stance raised some concerns amongst the operators—when the one we need to trust is the controversial figure at the heart of the Chernobog Incident, any interaction should be subject to greater scrutiny.
In the end, we gave Ch'en our tacit approval after extensive discussion. Ch'en has undoubtedly become an important and trustworthy member of Rhodes Island, demonstrating her oversight responsibility with concrete action, and helping the new Reunion take crucial first steps toward winning trust.

'The children look forward to Hui-chieh's visits. Although supplies are never plentiful, they have been learning to sew teddy bears because they think she loves them after she was seen gazing at a teddy bear, lost in thought.'
'I know a lot of the resources and news that Ch'en brought came from Rhodes Island, and I understand your reservations about me. I can't guarantee that there will be a perfect ending, nor do I expect us to truly understand one another, but I guarantee that Reunion will not repeat its old mistakes. Your torch is not the only one that burns bright. There are those who carry it into the darkest night, so that it may illuminate others.'

A great snowstorm struck many places in Yan, the likes of which had not been seen for a century. The snow lasted months, covering the land in white, and making the bright red figure traveling upon it particularly conspicuous. Rumors speak of a swordswoman who has been journeying across the land since last year, fighting for justice with her sword. She helped rebuild ruined houses in Baizao, punished bandits in Danyan, and cleared clogged water channels in Jiangqi... is she on some sort of quest? There are many differing opinions: some say she often asked those she helped where the local library was, and infer that she was seeking some secret tome that would allow her to break through a bottleneck in her training; others have seen her visit cemeteries, and believe her to be following the trail of a departed friend; and others claim that she often visited the sites where schools and colleges once stood, and hypothesize that she is a Tianshi, sent by the Ministry of Rites to investigate ancient sites... The only consensus is that there is no consensus. Some martial arts schools claimed her to be one of their students, only for the claim to be immediately shot down—'You're full of crap! She doesn't even know your dialect. How could she have studied there for decades?' Others have tried to challenge her to a duel. The first challenger recalls that she readily accepted his challenge, but he was stunned when she spoke a line straight out of a kung fu film. She was clearly unfamiliar with the modern-day martial arts landscape of Yan. Subsequent challengers were no longer met with the same flowery lines. My investigation indicates that our heroine has moved north, and it remains to be seen whether we will see her emerge in Dahuang or Lungmen next. I would like to close this column with a word of advice... challenging her is really not for the faint of heart, or anyone who is not supremely confident in their skills! —Excerpt from Jianghu Monthly, Issue 02, 1103 [Classified Log] Ch'en's request for field assignment in Yan is hereby approved. The Tomb of Sui incident carries tremendous significance for both Yan and Terra as a whole. For Yan, it meant the resolution of a thousand-year affliction; for Terra, it was a relief to know that the Jingyu Prime Vein was not being depleted at nearly the same rate as the Kolossal Prime Vein, even though neither Rhodes Island nor Yan has been able to conclusively determine the current state of the first Originium. That does not mean, however, that Yan can fully escape this Terra-wide crisis. We had not previously made any association between Ch'en's matter and that of the Feranmuts. It was only when her identity and her 'family matter' became known to us that we realized her 'family matter' was, essentially, the family matter of Yan... Ch'en did not return to Yan's center of power following the resolution of the crisis at Baizao, instead opting to wander the lands in search of traces of a departed Sui proxy. Her reasons for taking up this responsibility are clearly linked to the writing knife that she obtained during her trip to Baizao. 'From Baizao to Shangshu, to Yumen and Lungmen... from south to north, from the heartlands to the frontiers, I discovered many traces that the proxy left behind. If she managed to bring writing and history to such distant lands back then, perhaps the land of fairness and justice we are seeking really does exist after all.'

In the reports about the Tomb of Sui incident that the Yanese operators submitted, nothing caught our attention more than the account of Ch'en stopping Yumen with a single swing of her sword. According to Zuo Le, Ch'en cut power to all of Yumen in an instant using nothing more than a tiny writing knife, buying crucial time for him to neutralize the remaining artillery positions. Nian's account, on the other hand, was rather different: 'She was muttering something like As sword of heaven's plaint, bid dawn as cast, then there was a gust of sandstorm, and then Yumen just stopped. What do you mean my statement was as vague and incomprehensible as my films? You can ask the others if you don't believe me—did you hear that, Shu? They don't believe me!' Her shouting caught the attention of the other Yanese operators present. Mr. Nothing heard the story, waved his fan, and walked away with a profound expression on his face. It took only a few days for the legend of how Ch'en stopped Yumen with a single swing to spread throughout Rhodes Island. And so, the next time Ch'en returned to Rhodes Island and walked into the training room, she saw every pair of curious eyes in the room fixated on her... After learning what had happened, Ch'en agreed to do a demonstration in the outdoor training grounds. But she did not draw Chi Xiao—instead, she made the gesture of a sword with her fingers, turned her wrists, stepped forward, lowered her shoulder, and swung upwards lightly—there was no breathtaking aura, but the wind began to blow, stirring up sand and dust. A few seconds later, the sandstorm cleared, and the clouds parted to reveal the sun. It took a little while for the spectators to process what had just happened. The move seemed utterly unremarkable, yet clearly extraordinary. What made it so powerful? No one dared ask, seeing the solemn expression on Ch'en's face. Observing from the side, Qiubai and Yun Qingping revealed the secret— 'It was like a ray of light breaking through the clouds, but still connected to the soil on the ground.' 'My master once said that mindset was the most important thing to the Chi Xiao style. The swing just now was very different from the traditional finishing move of Chi Xiao. If the philosophy of Lord Wei's sword is to strike with no regret, Miss Ch'en's sword represents the admission and acceptance of regret, to press forward regardless of regret.' 'That's what makes Ch'en different from Chief Wei.' 'What's that supposed to mean? Did you understand a word of that, stinking rat?' '...There was already a hint of that move in her sword when she was in Yumen.' 'Yumen? She was in Yumen when you were there? ...Hey, why aren't you saying anything? Why are you walking away? Did you really understand that? Wait up!' 'Take it easy, Missy—the move sends the message that Ch'en never gives up partway.' As sword of heaven's plaint, bid dawn as cast. Never fear, never waver, long though the journey be. The light shines through when the clouds part. One must overcome the obstacles of one's own heart to fully comprehend the way of the sword. The sword begins and ends with the heart, but the spirit of the sword lingers. Those who fail to act because something seems impossible shall lose their spirit, and their sword lose its soul. —This segment has been rewritten many times; Ch'en says she is still working on it

As Ch'en sent back more and more reports during her time in Ursus, we set up a dedicated storage area for them at the Doctor's suggestion. Reviewing these reports made us realize just how long Ch'en has been with us. From Summary of Conditions in Lungmen Slums and Tripartite Investigation Report of the Governments of Dossoles and Bolívar, to Development of Law and Order in Columbia and Challenges in Implementation and Overview of Victorian Dukes and Tara, to the recent reports on Ursus and Yan, these are not just raw intelligence collected by Ch'en, but also focused and astute observations and commentaries made by someone embarking on a long journey. They are of great significance to both Rhodes Island and Ch'en herself. The fact that Ch'en is part of Yan's imperial bloodline is no longer a secret on Rhodes Island, but she has not been shunned or approached because of it. Perhaps it is because she has already left a deep impression fighting alongside the others as a former Lungmen cop, or perhaps it is because the significance of her bloodline pales in comparison to her experiences across Terra. While Ch'en keeps her distance from the Yanese government, it does not mean she no longer cares about the country. She has never truly left Yan—or rather, she has never truly left Lungmen. She is still searching for a land of fairness and justice, and she hopes that she will find it in the soil that she stands upon, but she is not bound by this land, nor by any other. For us, the most valuable thing about Ch'en has never been her position, but her will and direction. She does not belong entirely to Rhodes Island, but her goal of seeking a land of fairness and justice aligns closely with Rhodes Island's mission. Operators who have gone on field missions with her say that there is a sort of certainty about Ch'en that is reassuring—she understands what she is seeking, and has never wavered. While the concepts of fairness and justice may differ somewhat from language to language and context to context, they ultimately point toward the same conviction: a belief in a better tomorrow. We all believe that Terra will become better than it is today. 'Officer Ch'en—no, Ch'en is our comrade and kindred spirit, one of Rhodes Island's most important partners. Of that there is no doubt. Elite operator? Ahem... she understands what she wants all too well, and our paths will not necessarily always be aligned—of course, a consistent presence at headquarters or squad operation has never been a criterion for elite operator selection... Perhaps you could ask her yourself the next time she comes back?'

I saw a village burned to the ground in the north. The charred remains stood out in the white snow. There were signs of fighting, and bodies of both uninfected and infected people. I'm not sure what happened there.
Are such scenes a regular sight in Ursus?
Did you see the same thing when you were in Ursus, all those years ago?

Received communication from Rhodes Island. Something has happened to the Doctor's team. HQ has sent a special task force to Ursus, and I have a feeling you'll run into them again.
Security is really tightening in the Far North. I was thoroughly questioned and searched just walking into an ordinary hotel today.
There are a lot of movements from many different directions. I do not yet have a clear view... but I'll get to the bottom of it.

Received a letter from Madam Fumizuki yesterday...
The events in the Far North were just the beginning. Ursus is facing an even greater crisis. If the events truly have implications across all of Terra, as the Doctor predicted, Yan will not stand idly by, and Wei Yenwu certainly will not. He will do something.
Should I...

Back in Victoria, you encouraged me to do what I had already made up my mind to do. I found you again, but we still do not know the truth. Mother, your father, that pathetic man, and Wei Yenwu... We should have been told the truth about what happened. We have a right to know. Perhaps you don't care anymore, but I can't cast it aside so easily.
Someone told me that those old folks were young and ambitious once. What happened to them? Their ambitions grew rusty, and the only thing they have left is silence, keeping them from telling the truth... I must go back, to Lungmen, to Baizao. If they will not tell the truth, I will find it myself.
I ran away many times, but I don't plan on running away forever—you didn't run away either, did you?
Heaven burned red over Grypherburg that night... the fire on the ground burned for a long time. Buildings were collapsing, and other things were collapsing with them. The stubborn stone split apart in the fire, and light shone out through the crack... I still see the fire when I close my eyes, and it gives me the courage to walk toward the truth.
I think I'm ready. I'm going back.
...Can you hear it, Tal?
I'm going back.

[The letters are neatly folded, but were never sent.]

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: So, do you want a bodyguard, or a cop to watch you work 24/7? Just joking. I haven't forgotten how you do things here.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: It's Rhodes Island's visitor logs? Swire, Hoshiguma, and Lin too… Right, assuming they're always asking about me, but there's no way they're coming this much for—Hm. I know a lot of people are waiting for me. It's not too bad, being on someone's mind.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Worried about my health? Guess we ought to be checking up on each other, Doctor. I've been through a lot these past few years, time sure does fly. The more you experience, the easier it is to fall into confusion and helplessness. Sometimes I do need a reminder… my time is not infinite.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Oh, you've noticed my blade? I was told it can erase history's mistakes, but that's practically half of whatever's been archived in the last thousand years, and there's no way a single blade could clean that all up. Let's look to the future instead—the ideals we seek still lie ahead.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I followed her and Reunion to many places, and saw many sacrifices made. The people went from being lost and fragmented to becoming united and awakened—on that long and winding road. Many of them were left behind in the huge blaze in Deity Grypherburg, yet it was this very fire that ignited their hope.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: We're a long way from a place where everyone is treated equally, and I have no clue if I'm any nearer to this goal. But I've never doubted the equality I envision is real, for when we step up to rage against the injustice we see, we prove it exists.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've been back to Lungmen a few times. Other than the loss of my favorite cheongfun shop, the changes are nice to see. There are fewer L.G.D. patrols on the streets, and you hear less talk of the slums… There's no lying to myself and pretending I don't care for the city.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I asked that man why my mother and sister had to suffer, and unsurprisingly, I didn't get the answer I was looking for. It's too bad Chi Xiao can't sever blood ties, and this writing knife can't scrape away recorded history either. There's no granting any forgiveness in their stead, no one is worth sacrificing for any 'greater good', ever.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: When things calm down, it would be nice to take you around Yan. Not just Lungmen, and not for any investigations either. Just a trip to watch the people make something from nothing in that beautiful land. There's nowhere else like it. You won't have to pack anything either. A sword and a boat. That's all we'll need.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Need a break, but can't sleep? Yeah, you have a lot of pressure on your shoulders. Sit up straight. I'll teach you some Yanese breathing exercises.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Long time no see, Doctor. I know things have gotten pretty serious, so I'm back to lend a hand. In case you need a reminder, I'm still with Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: This battle… Rhodes Island was there too?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: You have a lot of people who trust in your command, and depend on you to direct them… that's important to keep in mind.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I spent a long time mastering Chi Xiao's techniques, but the answer I got was different from the lessons I was taught. Chi Xiao has seen my determination, and when you need it, it will never waver.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Doesn't feel too unfamiliar yet.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Don't worry, I wasn't always on my own these past few years.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Move out. I'll make sure no one gets left behind.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Suppression by force isn't an option on this field.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Fear not the power of this blade.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I know very well why I draw this sword.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll stop all evil in its tracks.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Chi Xiao, unsheath—

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: As move unsheathing blade, cleave now as cleft.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: As move at teardrop's point, once known be deft.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: As sword of stratus rent, once stood stand fast!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: As sword of heaven's plaint, bid dawn as cast.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Nicely done, Doctor… you're mistaken. That light in the sky wasn't from my swordplay.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: One day, we won't have to make right with might.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: They'd best take this chance to repent.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Come on, don't lose heart over one setback.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Furnishings haven't changed. Nice.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, careful you don't poke yourself with the end of my blade.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You don't have to ask—I'm the same old Ch'en, haven't changed one bit.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: I've seen many different kinds of new years. Once, I watched a group take shelter under huge Originium clusters, promising each other everything would get better while they clinked muddy cups of water together, silently waiting for the sunrise… it's nothing, Doctor. This day only comes once a year, so let's go celebrate with the others.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you haven't changed one bit.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Perfect timing, Doctor. Here's a Bolívarian wood carving, a Victorian tea set, and an Ursine... I'm not asking you to choose, they're all for you. It's been a few years since we've seen each other, so I owe you a few birthday presents. Don't be shy. Happy birthday, Doctor.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I remember the first time I collaborated with Rhodes Island. A difficult fight, but a single Black Snake is nothing to worry about. What's scary is the countless villains out there who use despair to force people into doing their bidding. There's no winning our fights with brute force alone, so we have to keep improving ourselves.
